title: Initializer Version 1 Output Inventory
purpose: Complete closed inventory of every path the initializer produces in the initialized repository.

normative_requirements.text: The output inventory shall enumerate every destination path the initializer may create in the initialized repository.
Each inventory entry shall declare destination_path, producer, operation, role, type, mode, and required status.
The inventory shall declare prohibited_paths that shall not appear in the initialized repository worktree.
